_schema.measure: how the checker derives one number from an object's world-space bounding box: hex_across_flats = smaller of the two nearly-equal dims of a prism; axis_length = the odd dim of a prism/cylinder; round_diameter = mean of the nearly-equal pair; min_dim / mid_dim / max_dim = sorted bbox dims; height_z = world Z extent
_schema.range_m: [lo, hi] plausible real-world range. Values outside are flagged. Factor needed to enter range is reported.
_schema.basis: standard = taken from a published dimensional standard / manufacturer catalogue; code_min = building-code minimum (upper bound is heuristic); heuristic = engineering judgement, NOT a standard, weight lower
_schema.verified: true = value re-read from the cited page in this session (2026-10-03); false = from cited source but not re-fetched
_schema.match: regex (case-insensitive) on object name or custom property 'role'. First matching category wins (order matters: specific before generic). 'exclude' regex vetoes.
